From the bottom of my heart,

Any Master would know who this was.
Even #C236196003#FAMILY #GIVEN#CDEF recognizes that face.

The face of an young AI girl who, until just now,
was searching this Labyrinth with me.
That face belongs to none other than――

Good afternoon.
Nice to meet you, #C236196003#FAMILY#CDEF-senpai.

There's no turning back now, so you'd better

……what?

Don't be so stupid. From the top of my head

in their memory capacity――by now, she's an
